clips.prompt: Predawn kitchen, man at table reading his phone. Extremely slow push-in. He breathes slowly, thumb hovers over the unfinished message, phone screen glow flickers softly on his face, eyes tired. City lights out the window twinkle. Restrained handheld, photoreal, keep his face exactly as in the start frame, no morphing, subtle motion only. ARRI Alexa cinematic texture.

Night rain. Side profile of a man pressing his palm against a huge concrete wall veined with faint gold cracks. Rain streaks down the wall and his shoulders, fingers press slowly into the wet concrete, the gold cracks glow slightly brighter under his hand. Camera holds nearly still with restrained handheld drift. Photoreal, keep his face and tattoos exactly as in the start frame, no morphing.

Macro close-up of a hand resting on cracked concrete. Hairline aged-gold cracks slowly spread and brighten through the dark concrete like living veins, warm light pulsing gently through them. Sunset light grazes the surface. Very slow camera drift. Photoreal, tactile concrete texture, keep the man's profile stable, no morphing.

Subway car interior. Man with eyes closed leaning by the window, earbuds in, perfectly still, while the tunnel lights streak past the window behind him and reflections slide across the glass. The car sways gently, other passengers blur past in the background. Photoreal, keep his face exactly as in the start frame, no morphing.

Extreme close-up of a man's closed eyes. On the beat his eyes slowly open, calm and certain, and a warm aged-gold reflection blooms softly in his brown pupils. Micro movement only, skin texture photoreal, no morphing, camera locked with a breath of drift.

Warm Puerto Rican family kitchen with the flag on the wall. The family laughs together around the table, hands pass food, a grandmother touches a shoulder, the child looks up smiling, warm lamp light. Natural joyful motion, restrained handheld. Photoreal, keep every face consistent with the start frame, no morphing.

Two men face each other as the concrete wall between them loosens stone by stone, fragments drifting slowly free like gravity has softened, warm sunset light pouring through the widening gaps. No explosion, no violence, gentle inevitable release. Slow drift camera. Photoreal, keep both faces stable, no morphing.

Held close-up of two brothers in a tight imperfect embrace at sunrise, one hand gripping the back of the other's shirt, eyes closed, tears held back, breathing visibly. Micro movements only, deeply tender. Golden hour light. Photoreal, keep both faces exactly as in the start frame, no morphing.

Night city street. A man stands centered while three mythic guardians stand behind him as quiet witnesses: a lion warrior, a donkey in tactical gear, a black jackal woman in gold Egyptian armor. Almost still tableau, coats and mane stir in the wind, wet asphalt reflections shimmer, slow push-in. Photoreal, keep all four figures exactly as in the start frame, no morphing.
